description: This file declares ANGLE-specific enum classes for OpenGL ES enums and functions to operate on them, including enum iteration, mapping, and resource handle management.

classes.name: angle::EnumIterator
classes.description: Iterator for enumerating over enum values.

classes.name: angle::AllEnums
classes.description: Provides begin() and end() for iterating over all enum values.

classes.name: angle::PackedEnumMap
classes.description: A map indexed by enum values, similar to std::array.

classes.name: angle::PackedEnumBitSet
classes.description: A bitset indexed by enum values, similar to std::bitset.

methods.name: EnumSize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in a packed enum, including InvalidEnum.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first enum value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator past the last enum value.

methods.name: ToGLenum
methods.description: Converts enum to its GLenum representation.
